full_withdrawal_requested_occurred.meaning: a user has requested a full withdrawal of their maxAssets from a ProgressiveCurve market

multivault_full_balance_checkout_passed.meaning: the withdrawal passes the MultiVault full-balance checkout so share reduction is computed via previewWithdraw
multivault_full_balance_checkout_passed.checkpoint: before previewWithdraw share reduction is computed

shares_squared_before_withdraw.meaning: square(shares) at the pre-withdrawal checkpoint, the left side of the report's non-perfect-square relation

twice_assets_before_withdraw.meaning: 2 × assets at the pre-withdrawal checkpoint, the right side of the report's non-perfect-square relation, expressed in the same raw unit as square(shares)

withdrawal_completed_without_underflow.meaning: the full withdrawal completes without an arithmetic underflow in the preview calculation

assumptions: The withdrawing user is treated as an arbitrary user of the ProgressiveCurve market; the report does not state ownership/authorization details.
The non-perfect-square condition is encoded as square(shares) < 2 × assets using the report's stated comparator and literal 2.
The MultiVault full-balance checkout is treated as a required step preceding previewWithdraw share reduction.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the exact numeric values of assets, shares, or SLOPE at the failing checkpoint, so the concrete underflow witness cannot be instantiated.
Report phrases the failing state inconsistently as an 'isolated state' versus 'any non-perfect square'; the general scope of the failure is not settled.
Report does not state whether the withdrawing user is authorized/owner of the position; only 'a user' is mentioned.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the cannot_fully_withdraw impact; other impacts are out of scope for this pass.
The impact is encoded as failure of the required completion effect (underflow preventing full withdrawal), not as a downstream economic loss.

The non-perfect-square relation is preserved with the report's literal 2 and strict less-than direction; both compared quantities are declared in one shared raw unit (shares_squared) so no product unit is formed.
Whether the underflow occurs for all non-perfect-square states or only isolated states remains a report ambiguity.
